name: Gänsleit
beschreibung:
Perched on a quiet, sunny slope in Soell, Hotel Gaensleit is an inviting holiday retreat for hikers and skiers. The hotel features comfortable rooms, relaxing spa amenities, and vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.

Access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and mountain trails are right at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gaensleit in Soell features cosy rooms, wellness, and scenic views at the base of Hohe Salve.
